contexts.text: It is believed to be enough to know...
To be enough from being () = if they cease.
An omer = as much as is sufficient... because it was the tenth part of an ephah... and a tenth part = as much as is sufficient.
It is enough that there is conjunction by means of the Word.
It is enough that man should know and acknowledge that they are from God...
It is enough that he should know and acknowledge these things from the Word...
It is enough for man to know truths, etc. AE 1174:3.
